checks_run.procedure: Verify F-DG6-960/970/980 adversarially. (1) A probe with an ECHO fake model: it answers with the last assistant message in its history, else a neutral text that names no record. R1 is my round-2 sequence. R2 tests transitive inheritance past the 6-message window (A1 from tA1+tA2, A2..A5 from tA3 only, with the echo carrying A1's text; then tA2 is revoked). R3 restores the grant. It runs together with history-recheck.test.ts and context-recheck.test.ts. (2) Mutants: M1 keeps withheld answers in historyFor; M2 removes the inherited context. (3) Line review of the repair diff 71ff750ed..f56f1b3d: every path that feeds earlier turns or records to the model, the inheritance cap, and the 0128→0129 window.
checks_run.command: tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project integration apps/api/test/integration/assistant/{zz-domain-r3-history,history-recheck,context-recheck}.test.ts (QA_PG_PORT=32400); the same with each mutant (port 32410)
checks_run.environment: Clone at f56f1b3d; disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 (UTF8/C, 121 migrations); the shipped http_endpoint provider pointed at the local fake chat-completions server (a loopback test double, not a model or an IT endpoint). Synthetic data.
checks_run.expected: A withheld answer is not sent as history and is not re-served. A new answer inherits the context of the history answers it was given, transitively. Each mutant is caught.
checks_run.actual: history-probe.log: 3 files, 12/12 passed, exit 0. R1: the turn-2 request roles are [system,user,user,user], so the withheld answer is dropped and the owner's prompt stays. History holds TITLE_2 = false, and tA2 is not in the data block. The reply is the neutral text, and the GET does not name TITLE_2. R2: the stored contexts of A1..A5 all include tA2. After the revocation, all of A1..A5 have contentWithheld true, although A1 is outside the last turns' window. Turn 6 holds no TITLE_2 in its history and serves none. R3: after the TL grant is restored, all answers are readable again. Mutants: M1 fails 5 of 7, exit 1. M2 fails 2 of 7 (history-recheck 'inheritance' and my R2), exit 1. Both were restored, and git status showed only my untracked probe files. Line review: historyFor applies the same withheld()/readabilityOf predicate as toMessageView, for first.fresh, before answer() calls the provider. A grant revoked during the model call itself is the same narrow window as any request in flight, and the next read re-checks it. answer.ts:142 is the only call to ModelProvider.complete, and conversations.ts:821 is the only call to answer (grep). The 'Test connection' path sends no history. Suggestions store outcome.contextRecords (conversations.ts:853), so they inherit too. The cap: the retrieval limit is min(max_context_records ≤ 20, MAX_ITEMS), a conversation holds at most 100 messages (so at most 50 answers), and the inheritance is transitive within one conversation, so 1,000 keys is the exact bound. The fail-closed drop only removes history and never truncates a stored context. I accept it. The 0128→0129 window: answers stored by an intermediate P6 build between 0128 and 0129 do not inherit. Defence 1 (the history re-check) still keeps a withheld answer from reaching the model again. Only an answer that an older build already generated from such history could stay readable, and no released installation holds those rows (P6 is unreleased). The data dictionary discloses this. I accept it as a residual, not a defect.
